How do I charge my Ather 450X?

The Ather 450X can be charged using the Ather Dot home charger (included) or at any Ather Grid public charging station. To charge at home, plug the Ather Dot into a standard 5A or 15A socket. A full charge from 0-100% takes approximately 5 hours 45 minutes on a 15A socket. The scooter also supports fast charging at Ather Grid stations, which can charge 0-80% in about 1 hour 10 minutes. The charging port is located under the seat on the left side.

What is the range of the Ather 450X?

The Ather 450X offers a certified range of 146 km (IDC) in Eco mode. In real-world conditions, riders typically get 85-105 km on a single charge depending on riding style, load, and terrain. The 450X has a 2.9 kWh lithium-ion battery. Warp mode (highest performance) will reduce range to approximately 70-80 km. The battery is IP67 rated and is warranted for 3 years or 30,000 km, whichever comes first.

What is covered under the Ather 450X warranty?

Ather provides a 3-year / 30,000 km warranty on the battery and motor, whichever comes first. The vehicle warranty (frame, fork, suspension) is 3 years or 30,000 km. Wear-and-tear items such as tyres, brake pads, and brake shoes are not covered under warranty. Warranty is void if the scooter is modified, involved in an accident, or serviced by an unauthorised service centre.

How often does the Ather 450X need servicing?

Ather recommends a service every 6 months or 5,000 km, whichever comes first. The first free service is at 750 km or 1 month. Unlike petrol scooters, the 450X has no engine oil, spark plugs, or air filter to replace. Regular maintenance covers brake inspection, tyre pressure check, throttle and brake cable check, and software updates. All Ather service centres are authorised — do not take the scooter to a general mechanic.

What are the riding modes on Ather 450X?

The Ather 450X has four riding modes: Eco, Ride, Sport, and Warp. Eco mode limits top speed to 45 km/h and maximises range. Ride mode is for regular city riding with a top speed of 60 km/h. Sport mode offers increased acceleration and a top speed of 80 km/h. Warp mode is the highest performance mode with a top speed of 90 km/h and 0-60 km/h acceleration in 5.1 seconds. Warp mode is only available on the 450X Pro variant.

Does Ather 450X support OTA updates?

Yes, the Ather 450X supports over-the-air (OTA) software updates delivered via Wi-Fi. The scooter has a built-in 7-inch touchscreen dashboard with Android Auto support. Features include turn-by-turn navigation, call and music controls, and real-time tyre pressure monitoring. The Ather app (iOS and Android) allows remote monitoring of battery level, trip history, and charging status. The scooter connects via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. Updates are installed automatically when connected to Wi-Fi and parked.

What are the variants and price of the Ather 450X?

The Ather 450X is available in two variants: 450X and 450X Pro. The 450X starts at approximately ₹1,30,000 (ex-showroom, varies by city after FAME II subsidy). The 450X Pro includes Warp mode, additional connectivity features, and starts at approximately ₹1,45,000 (ex-showroom). Prices vary by state due to different subsidy structures. Ather also offers financing through partner banks with EMIs starting from approximately ₹3,500/month.

Where can I find Ather Grid charging stations?

Ather Grid is India's largest two-wheeler fast-charging network with 1,800+ charging points across 100+ cities. You can find the nearest charging point using the Ather app or the dashboard navigation. Ather Grid charging is free for Ather owners for the first year after purchase (One plan). After that, charging is billed per unit at ₹1.5/Wh. Third-party EV scooters are not supported at Ather Grid stations.

What safety features does the Ather 450X have?

The Ather 450X includes: Combined Braking System (CBS) for front and rear brake coordination, IP67-rated battery for water and dust resistance, geo-fencing alerts via the Ather app, theft detection and tow alerts, and a crash detection system. The scooter also has a side-stand motor cut-off (motor turns off if side stand is lowered while riding). The tyres are tubeless MRF with 12-inch alloy wheels.

How can I book a test ride or purchase the Ather 450X?

You can book a test ride through the Ather website (atherenergy.com) or the Ather app. Test rides are free and available at all Ather Experience Centres. To purchase, visit any Ather Experience Centre or order online. You need to pay a ₹2,000 booking amount to confirm the order, which is fully refundable. Delivery typically takes 2-4 weeks. Ather Experience Centres are present in 100+ cities across India.
